description: Welcome to Magnum_Opus. We are a school team from National Public School, Kolkata and a space research mapping brand formed 2 years ago. We are looking for enthusiastic teammates with distinguished skillsets in any field (everyone is helpful). Its completely fine if you have no skills at all; atleast a determined mindset will help as much as a fore-skilled person. There are zero boundaries for ages, we are welcoming everyone.
summary: RedNexus-Core is an interactive Martian exploration and mission-planning platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge, “Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map.” A lot of complex features are coded and decoded completely by SI whereas the design, UI and UX are made by us. Focused on Jezero Crater, it combines 2D and 3D terrain views with geological layers and hazard information to help users understand the landscape. Users can place waypoints, plan proposed traverses, and review route distance and elevation profiles. The platform also provides crew health and EVA safety guidance on concerns such as dust exposure, thermal stress, fatigue, and suit integrity. By bringing terrain exploration, route planning, hazard awareness, and safety information into one interface, RedNexus-Core makes Martian surface exploration easier to visualize and reason about. It is important because informed route planning can help people better understand the challenges of exploring Mars.
details: The applet opens up with the default 3d view of the Jezero crater. Use the drop down menu to choose a model to view. We recommend selecting the Gale Crater as its 2d map is rendered the fastest. The 2d tab features the 2d top-down view of the selcted 3d model in default MOLA Topography. Select 'Add Waypoint' option to add waypoints only after zooming to a certain level. Recommended to clear all the existing routes before planning a new one. The elevation profile show the ups and downs throughout the walk including the total distance to be covered. The table underneath shows the details between each waypoint. The Health monitoring system under the same tab features an AI voice Assistant.
